text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — GraniteAI (GRT-231) asked for a temporary rate lift and APAC egress allowlist after this morning's pilot run. Renewal in ~60d, they're nervous if demo next week doesn't hit SLAs.
jake_csm: they pushed a heavy indexing job overnight and saw token spikes. Demo Wed. If we can bump throughput and whitelist their SG edge IPs they'll continue.
sam_engineer: what's the requested bump? currently 100 rps org-wide.
maria_cs: they asked for 400 rps burst for 72h, plus SG region egress allowlist for 3 days. CIDRs shared via DM: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.45.
devon_oncall: ok. We can do a temporary rate_window change + ip allowlist. Need eng-infra and network sign-off. Also want auto-revert after 72h to avoid quota creep.
luis_network: can add routing allowlist for sg-edge. Need explicit CIDRs (got them). For region routing we need to update sg-1 route table and NAT rules. Will validate connectivity.
ingrid_eng: can implement bump if we add a circuit breaker: revert at 70% GPU util or after duration. Also prefer start window in a low-change period.
ops_bot: change_request created: CR-1861 by maria_cs. State: pending_approval.
sam_engineer: tagging @devon_oncall @luis_network for approval and scheduling.
devon_oncall: approve pending infra check. I'll schedule apply for a 72h window starting 1861235200. I'll handle apply + rollback and monitoring hooks.
maria_cs: noted. Also capturing customer feedback: tail latency for long prompts hit ~450ms — they want that on the model tuning backlog.
jake_csm: renewal note: mark renewal_risk=medium; follow-up scheduled 2 days after demo to review metrics and customer sentiment.
sam_engineer: plan to run: `redwoodctl tenant update --id GRT-231 --rate-limit 400 --burst 600 --duration 72h --allowlist 203.0.113.0/24,198.51.100.45 --region sg`
devon_oncall: running apply now, will enable circuit breaker and set revert timer. posting logs once live.
ops_bot: change_request CR-1861 state: applied by devon_oncall at 1861234580.
luis_network: routing rule sg-edge-allowlist-grt231 created, connectivity test to 198.51.100.45:443 succeeded from sg-edge nodes.
devon_oncall: monitor dashboards show increased rps for GRT-231 and stable latency under the circuit breaker. will auto-revert at end of window unless flagged.
maria_cs: :thumbsup: customer confirmed demo traffic flows and showbook ran. I'll log enablement notes and update the renewal chase.
jake_csm: closing loop — set renewal owner and move to high-touch for next 30d. thanks team!
